notes: Seed URL works over https; all results are on the single Elections page (page/sanjacinto.Elections), some served from newtools.cira.state.tx.us. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The server returns distinct per-file Last-Modified values, so upload times are usable, though a replaced file would hide an earlier upload. The 2024 and 2026 primary result files are image scans read visually; the 2026 primary pages carry Hart's 'Official Results' banner but are listed as unofficial and printed on election night. No precinct-by-precinct reports are posted for any of the three elections. Check 3 pending for the runoff (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-4): 2024_general LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2024-11-06 01:12 CT.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general LATER, 2026_primary LATER, 2026_runoff UNDETERMINED. Two or more elections share the result that maps to COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.)

2024_general.fact: '2024 JOINT GENERAL ELECTION RESULTS' = scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report SAN JACINTO COUNTY, TEXAS JOINT GENERAL ELECTION 11/5/2024 ... Unofficial Results ... Run Date 11/06/2024' (run time about 1:12 AM, read visually at low resolution), county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 15:07:28 GMT (9:07 AM CST Nov 6). No precinct report for 2024 is posted (never published online as far as the site shows). Rule 43: county totals first seen 2024-11-06 01:12 CT in 202411060.pdf (printed 'Run Time 1:12 AM Run Date 11/06/2024', confirmed at 90 dpi; no precinct report posted).

2026_primary.fact: Under '****UNOFFICIAL ELECTION RESULTS***': 'REPUBLICAN PARTY' (12 pages) and 'DEMOCRATIC PARTY' (9 pages), scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report SAN JACINTO COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY ELECTION 3/3/2026 ... Run Time 11:14 PM Run Date 03/03/2026', county totals; Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 17:21:34 GMT and 17:23:22 GMT (11:21 AM CST Mar 4). No precinct report is posted.

2026_runoff.fact: The runoff section lists only 'OFFICIAL RESULTS' = 'Cumulative Results Report ... Official Results ... Run Time 4:40 PM Run Date 06/03/2026' (county totals; Last-Modified Thu, 04 Jun 2026 20:56:22 GMT), reconciliation and PEHCA files; no election-night file. Check 3 pending.
